question: Which letter is 7th to the left of P in the English alphabet?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbb6cd3f57c558cc7893c80cdd59e8f2aae83c0793c16de8cd3d3052c84ca77c.png] 

Given: **P** is at position **16**.

⇒ Moving **7 steps left** → 16 − 7 = **9** → Position 9 = **I**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77928228f0f1be3b13fbf417b274eb65d72eb3b7d4afff7906c720d821bda560.png] 

So, the letter 7th to the left of P is **'I'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
